text: Driver reported: 'I stopped for a routine inspection near the depot. The rear door was open for about 10 minutes while I was checking the cargo. Temperature rose from 4°C to 5.5°C. I closed the door and the temperature is now recovering.'
Driver reported: 'Compressor started making unusual noise near Frankfurt. Temperature increased from 3°C to 8°C in 12 minutes. I stopped and called maintenance. Backup reefer has been dispatched.'
Driver reported: 'GPS signal lost in rural area near Lyons. Last known position: 45.76N, 4.83E. Temperature is stable at 4°C. Manual tracking initiated. Continuing on planned route.'

Driver reported: 'Severe thunderstorm near Brussels. External temperature dropped from 22°C to 10°C. Internal temperature fluctuated between 3°C and 6°C. I adjusted cooling settings. Monitoring closely.'
Driver reported: 'I set the temperature incorrectly to 0°C instead of 4°C. Corrected after 20 minutes. Temperature is now recovering to 4°C. Sorry for the error.'
Driver reported: 'Power outage at depot for 15 minutes during loading. Backup generator failed. Reefer unit restarted at 11:45. Temperature spiked to 9°C. I have requested immediate backup dispatch.'
Customer message: 'Please check the temperature on shipment #VAC-2042. The dashboard shows a minor deviation. Can you confirm the cargo is safe?'
Dispatcher note: 'Shipment #PHARMA-309 is running 2 hours late due to traffic congestion near Munich. Temperature is stable. Receiver has been notified.'
Maintenance report: 'Door seal on reefer unit #R-1022 has been replaced. The old seal was degraded and allowed warm air entry. Unit is now operating normally.'
